compute_constrained_decoding_metric: compute constrained decoding metrics from HuggingFace model output scores, logits, and sequences
compute_reject_prob_drop: compute rejection probability drop from constraint using scores and logits tensors
save_metric_output_to_csv: save ConstrainedDecodingMetricOutput tensors as CSV files to a specified directory
load_metric_output_from_csv: load ConstrainedDecodingMetricOutput from CSV files and recreate the object with tensors
convert_metric_output_to_dataframe: convert ConstrainedDecodingMetricOutput tensors to labeled pandas DataFrames for analysis
